generation_prompt: The robot closes its right hand around the Rubik's cube on the upper level of the wooden shelf and lifts it clear. It carries the cube down to the bottom level, sets it upright, and opens its right hand to release it, leaving the cube resting on the lower shelf. Keep the camera fixed; preserve robot geometry, physically valid joint motion, and normal gripper opening and closing.
observed_terminal_state: The Rubik's cube stands upright on the bottom wooden shelf with its white face upward and green face forward. The right hand is open adjacent to it with the fingers and thumb clear of the cube; the left hand remains open and idle. The upper shelf is empty.

arm_hand_roles.right: Sole manipulator: reaches to upper shelf, closes fingers and thumb around cube, lifts, transports downward, lowers onto bottom shelf, and opens to release.
arm_hand_roles.left: Remains open beside the left side of the robot; no object contact, stabilization, transfer, or coordinated support.

uncertainties: The precise instant of first cube-to-bottom-shelf contact is partially occluded by the right hand; placement and release are evident by the final native frames.

data_quality_gate.rule: Variance of the Laplacian of the luma of the model-view frame (cover-resize to the nearest-aspect 720p-class bucket, center crop); pass if >= 120 third-person, >= 60 first-person.
